translation.question: 2025年10月2日，C/2025 R2 (SWAN) 经过了哪个天体附近？
translation.translation_note: Zubenelgenubi is Alpha Librae, whose standard Chinese astronomical name is 氐宿一 (Di Xiu Yi).

backtranslation_en.question: On October 2, 2025, which celestial body did C/2025 R2 (SWAN) pass near?

consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer (Zubenelgenubi is Alpha Librae, which is 氐宿一 in Chinese).
